evidence: BTAO thin films were deposited at 250°C on 8 in. silicon wafers (p-type) in nanolaminate forms through an alternating growth of BT and alumina layers by ALD. For the BT ALD, a mixed solution of Bi(mmp)3, and Ti(mmp)4 (mmp = 1-methoxy-2-methyl-2-propoxide) was injected twice in 1 s and subsequently purged with argon gas (1600 sccm) for 5 s. The Bi and Ti-adsorbed substrate was oxidized by a water pulse for 3 s and then purged again with argon gas. For the alumina ALD, the feeding times of trimethylaluminum (TMA) and water vapor were 0.5 and 2 s, respectively, and the purging times were 5 s.
